== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of the 7 side (Indentured To The Empire) of [[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire (Errata)]] (current card <code>1282_10</code>), showing the '''PC-E1''' text of the Competitive Balance Team errata of 23 July 2014. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text. The Players Committee card image ([[:File:VB8-D-indenturedtotheempire-pre.gif]]) and the release-sheet slip print the original text ([[Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire]]).

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee rules forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post of 23 July 2014 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p894811 forum post]), read in the live post: “battlegrounds” struck, “locations” added; the post writes the bold first words in braces.
* '''PC-E1 text (7 side):''' “While this side up, whenever you 'enslave' a character, opponent must choose to use 2 Force or lose 1 Force. Once per turn, during battle may add or subtract up to X from your just drawn destiny, where X = the number of Kashyyyk locations you control with a slaver. Once per turn, if you just retrieved Force during battle, may take a slaver, starship, or vehicle retrieved into hand. Flip this card if opponent controls two Kashyyyk locations.”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 73) (CardMaker draws Objective fronts only: the spec was the card's own Virtual Legacy card with the 7-side title, destiny 7, caption •Death Star II (V) and the PC-E1 text); the art window was then filled with the art of the release-sheet slip of this side ([[:File:VB8-07-Wookiee_Slaving_Operation_Indentured_To_The_Empire.png]]). Holotable size, 745 × 1039.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
